title: Protesters block Brooklyn Bridge to protest ICE shooting and demand ICE leave NYC
seoTitle: New York City protest over ICE shooting

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated in response to an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) shooting in Marble Hill earlier that month.
tea.want: Demonstrators called on ICE to leave New York City and demanded the release of a detained individual named Oscar Belgal.
tea.changed: Oct 28: Authorities reported that about 14 protesters were arrested after blocking traffic on the Brooklyn Bridge.

summary: On Wednesday afternoon, a group of about 30 activists gathered to block traffic on the Manhattan side of the Brooklyn Bridge in New York City. According to the participants, the demonstration was held in response to an ICE shooting in Marble Hill earlier in the month. The group called for ICE to leave New York City and demanded the release of Oscar Belgal, an immigrant from the Dominican Republic who had been shot and detained by ICE agents in the Bronx. The protest disrupted traffic entering Manhattan and caused delays. Law enforcement and authorities intervened, taking multiple individuals into custody and reopening all lanes of traffic by early afternoon.
demands: ICE to leave New York City
response: According to authorities and law enforcement sources, about 13 to 14 protesters were arrested after blocking traffic, and police reopened all bridge lanes shortly before 1:30 p.m.

updates.text: Protesters blocked traffic on the Manhattan side of the Brooklyn Bridge during the afternoon.
Authorities reported that about 14 protesters were arrested during the demonstration.
Officials reopened all lanes on the Brooklyn Bridge shortly before 1:30 p.m.
